title: Apocalyptic Symbols
summary: Apocalyptic symbols use vivid images to reveal heavenly realities, judgment, hope, and God’s rule.
background: Books like Daniel, Ezekiel, Zechariah, and Revelation use symbolic visions. The images are not random; they communicate theological truth through prophetic imagery.
teachingHelp: Teach apocalyptic imagery carefully, explaining symbols from Scripture while keeping the focus on God’s victory and faithfulness.
